name: figma-audit-design-system
title_zh: 设计系统体检报告，连组件债主一起点名
tagline_zh: 接手别人的 Figma 文件，组件命名乱、变量没人用、样式重复几十套，翻半天也说不清哪里烂。
tagline_en: Inherited a messy Figma file? It reads through MCP, inventories components, variables, tokens, patterns and.
desc_en: Analyze, audit, inventory, and document an existing Figma design system through the Figma MCP server — components, variables, tokens, patterns, design debt, usage rules, causal relationships — and create design-system documentation pages in Figma on request. Use when the user asks to audit, inventory, map, document, or find debt in a Figma file, page, frame, component set, or selection. Read-only
why_zh: 别人只给你一张组件截图，它给你的是带因果的账本：谁引用了谁、哪套样式已经没人用、债务从哪次改动开始堆。
why_en: Not just a component screenshot — a causal ledger: who references whom, which styles are dead, and where the debt started piling.
limit_zh: 必须接上 Figma MCP server 且账号对该文件有读取权限，否则一步都走不了；只读，不会替你改组件。
limit_en: Requires the Figma MCP server and read access to the file; read-only, it never renames or cleans anything, and it only covers Figma — not code.
title_en: A design-system health report that names every component.
